description: The Thünen Institute and collaborators assembled GHG-DB-Thuenen from eight German energy-crop field trials over the 2011/2012 to 2014/2015 seasons. Its 43 million records connect gas fluxes, crop growth and yield, soil characteristics, weather, management events and calculated carbon and nitrogen balances. Crops include maize and oilseed rape. OpenAgrar lists six Microsoft Access databases and supporting documentation under a CC BY 4.0 licence, with public file links and no price shown. Weather was recorded continuously, but the landing page does not give a single resolution for every variable or the precise location of each trial. Crop and land-use modellers could compare emission or yield predictions with observed field conditions and test assumptions about nitrogen management. The eight trials do not constitute a national emissions inventory. The large Access files were not downloaded, so table relationships and data quality remain untested. The catalogue’s US agriculture and forestry greenhouse-gas inventory is a national aggregate with a different purpose; this record preserves the separate German field-measurement dataset. For simulation, the observations support climate-adaptation scenarios and crop-production capacity planning at field scale. This record is related to the catalogue US agriculture and forestry greenhouse-gas inventory, but has field-level German measurements.
name: GHG-DB-Thuenen – Multi-variable experimental data set of agronomic data and gaseous soil emissions of energy crop cultivation at eight sites in Germany
notes: G4-0590; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
